payout_quote: When a new user ('Referee') signs up for Kalshi using that link, opens an account, and satisfies the eligibility requirements below, both the Referrer and the Referee may become eligible to receive a bonus credit under the Referral Program. ... For an offer of 'up to $500' ... Referrer and/or Referee are each independently eligible for their own 'up to $500' bonus credit. ... Each user may refer a maximum of 40 users under the Referral Program.
timing: Bonus credit posts after the referred friend completes KYC and transacts $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening; credit expires 7 days after grant; non-withdrawable, only trading profits withdrawable
eligibility: Referrer: existing Kalshi user in good standing who has transacted at least $25 on Predictions. Referee: new Kalshi user, US person, completes KYC, transacts at least $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening; max 40 referrals per user; referral link OR promo code, not both
steps: As an existing Kalshi user, transact at least $25 on Predictions to unlock your referral link
Send your personal referral link to a friend
Friend signs up via the link, completes KYC, and transacts $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening
Both you and your friend each receive a variable bonus credit ($15-$500)
Trade the credit within 7 days; withdraw only profits
catches: this is a bet, not income: bonus credit is non-withdrawable trading credit that must be traded (playthrough) before anything can be withdrawn; only profits from trading it can become cash, and event contracts can lose 100%.
Same lottery odds as the promo code program: 70% of participants get just $15, and receipt of any tier is not guaranteed.
Both sides must independently qualify - if your friend fails KYC or doesn't trade $25 within 7 days, neither of you gets anything.
Bonus credit expires 7 days after grant.
biggest_catch: this is a bet, not income: both you and your friend must each risk $25 of trading activity to qualify, the reward is usually just $15 in non-withdrawable credit that expires in 7 days, and only trading profits can ever be withdrawn.
notes: Distinct campaign from R6800 (Referral Program vs Promo Code Program), governed by the same official Kalshi terms document (kalshi.com/tc/500). Per-side cap: 40 referrals. Realistic value per successful referral pair is ~$21.35 expected credit each, non-withdrawable.

repeatable.cadence: repeatable per referred friend, up to 40 referrals per user; each friend's bonus is one-time

maximize: This is the repeat loop: up to 40 referrals per user, each worth ~$21 in expected credit. Don't spray the link - a referral only pays if your friend finishes KYC and trades $25 within 7 days, so only send it to people who will actually do it, and walk them through the qualifying trade on day one. Dead signups pay neither side.
who_pays: Kalshi pays both sides' bonus credit out of its own promo budget.
who_qualifies: Referrer: an existing Kalshi user in good standing who has already transacted at least $25 on Predictions. Friend: a new Kalshi user, US person, who completes identity verification (KYC) and transacts $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening. Max 40 referrals per user; one account per person; referral link OR promo code, not both. Minimum age and exact state availability: unverified.
what_gets_accepted: Your friend signs up via your referral link, finishes KYC, and trades $25 on Predictions within 7 days of opening. Both you and your friend then each independently receive a variable bonus credit ($15-$500 per the official tier table).
costs_and_unpaid_time: No cash cost to you. Your friend must put up $25 of their own trading activity, which can lose 100%. Your unpaid time: ~10-20 minutes per friend to send the link and help them through KYC and the qualifying trade.
when_cash_arrives: Nothing arrives as cash. Credit posts after your friend qualifies, expires 7 days after grant, is non-withdrawable, and only profits from trading the credit can ever be withdrawn.
